name: Get User Permissions
description: Call this when you need to know which loyalty‑program actions the currently authenticated user is allowed to perform and whether they are the program owner. Use a program‑detail endpoint (e.g. /loyalty/get-program) instead when you need information about the program itself rather than the user's rights.
preconditions: The request must be made by an authenticated user who belongs to a loyalty program.

actions.description: List of permission identifiers the user has for the loyalty program.

is_owner.description: True if the user is the owner of the loyalty program.
